The frame is layered with a busy live-stream interface, including a scrolling comment section at the bottom, floating heart icons, and top-corner user IDs. (2) The group transitions into a synchronized rhythmic routine. They lean their torsos forward in unison while pointing their index fingers toward the viewer. Their movements are snappy and coordinated, matching a perceived beat. Facial expressions become more animated, with several characters winking and maintaining wide, enthusiastic smiles. High-frequency digital overlays, including gift icons and multipliers like 'x21', flicker across the lower-center of the screen, partially obscuring their legs. In the final moments, the entire group raises their hands to wave goodbye toward the lens while maintaining their smiling expressions. The background digital sparkles continue to pulse, and the yellow text overlays at the bottom shift rapidly as the scene concludes.
